integrity_notes: The displayed theorem is supported by a universal integer-degree argument and a universal constructive family. Finite checks supplement but do not replace the proofs.
limitations: Theorem covers ordinary unit-edge finite cycles and commuting vertex-prefix retractions, not weighted or centered cycles.

title: The quarter-circumference law for commuting retractions of finite metric cycles
